NumberFormat.description: How a counter writes its number.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point, at most 6. Default 0.

thousands.description: Put between each group of three integer digits, as `,`. Default none.

OffsetStop.description: A gradient color at a set position.

anyOf.description: Colors along a line across the area.
One color: CSS hex or the project's color object.

PaintChoice.description: A color, a theme color, or a gradient.

PlacedChild.description: A box child with item fields.

box.description: Item fields of an engine layout box, as it writes them; lengths may be theme lengths.

Ramp.description: A change from one value to another; before it the value is `from`, after it `to`.

at.description: When it starts. Default 0.

duration.description: How long it lasts. Default: to the node's end.

Ramp2.description: A change from one value to another; before it the value is `from`, after it `to`.

at.description: When it starts. Default 0.

duration.description: How long it lasts. Default: to the node's end.

Reveal.description: A text revealed a unit at a time. Each unit moves at a constant rate over `duration`.

by.description: The unit: `word` (words holding a letter or digit) or `line` (laid-out lines).

distance.description: How far a `rise` moves, in pixels. Default half the font size.

duration.description: Seconds each unit takes. Default: the theme's fade length.

stagger.description: Seconds between one unit's start and the next's. Default half the duration.

type.description: How each unit appears: `fade`, or `rise` (fading in while moving up). Default `fade`.

RevealUnit.description: The unit a text is revealed by.

oneOf.description: Words that hold a letter or digit; other characters show throughout.

Size.description: A size in pixels, or one of the theme's lengths.

anyOf.description: CSS hex or the color object.

SolidColor.description: One color: a theme color, CSS hex, or the project's color object.

position.description: Where their text's middle lies, as fractions of the canvas, `(0, 0)` top-left.

anyOf.description: A color at a set position.
A color, spaced evenly with the others.

dash.description: Dash and gap lengths, as fractions of the area's shorter side. Default: solid.

paint.description: What covers it. Default: the theme's text color.

width.description: Width, as a fraction of the area's shorter side.

TextFit.description: The font sizes a text is fitted between, in pixels.

max.description: Largest font size. Default: the text's font size, so it only shrinks.

min.description: Smallest font size; when nothing larger fits, the text draws at this size.

Theme.description:
How text, panels and timings look. Parts left out come from the base theme. Sizes are
fractions of the canvas's shorter side, so a theme looks the same on wide and tall canvases.

accent.description: A highlight: a lower third's bar.

base.description: The built-in theme this one changes. Default `clean-dark`.

fade_seconds.description: How long text and cards fade in and out, in seconds.

font_family.description:
Font family, as the font names it. Unset, text draws in the first font an export
registers.

margin.description: The space kept clear at the canvas's edges.

panel.description: The boxes behind labels, lower thirds and boxed captions.

still_seconds.description: How long a still shows when nothing says, in seconds.

surface.description: What title and end cards are drawn on.

text_seconds.description: How long a card or text shows when nothing says, in seconds.

transition.description: The transition a slideshow, or a sequence asking for `theme`, puts between children.

ThemeChoice.description: A theme by name, or one built on a named theme.

ThemeColor.description: A theme color, so a design follows whatever theme it is drawn with.

ThemeLength.description:
One of the theme's lengths times `scale`, so a design follows the theme it is drawn with: a
fraction of the picture's shorter side.

scale.description: What it is multiplied by. Default 1.

Transition.description: The transition between two neighbours of a sequence.

duration.description: How long the neighbours overlap, in seconds.

type.description:
`crossfade`, a built-in transition's short name (`wipe-left`, `circle-open`, ...), or a
full effect id (`alpha2.transition.fade`).

anyOf.description:
`none` for cuts, `theme` for the theme's transition, or a transition name at the theme's
duration.

TransitionChoice.description: A sequence's transitions: none, the theme's, or one given.

Trim.description: The part of outlines' length that is kept, from `start` to `end`, shifted by `offset` turns.

WhenLong.description: What a video longer than its node does.

oneOf.description: Speeds up to fit the node.

WhenShort.description: What a video shorter than its node does once it ends.

description: A whole video: a body, what is drawn over it, and what plays under it.

$schema.description:
The schema the spec follows (`https://alpha2.sh/schema/compose.v1.json`), for editors and
validators. The compiler does not read it.

audio.description: Sound beside the body's: `audio` and `music_bed` nodes, placed as overlays are.

body.description:
The main picture, from time zero. Its length is the video's unless `duration` says
otherwise.

compose_version.description: Spec version. This build reads only [`COMPOSE_VERSION`].

duration.description: The video's length in seconds. Default: the body's.

loudness.description:
The loudness an export normalizes the mix to. Returned as an export option, not stored
in the project.

overlays.description:
Nodes drawn over the body in order, placed by their own `at` (default 0) and lasting to
the end unless they say otherwise.

theme.description: Fonts, colors, sizes and default timings. Default `clean-dark`.
